summary: Telomir Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K announcing FDA clearance of its IND for Telomir-Zn in triple-negative breast cancer. No financial terms, stake, price, premium, or board recommendation are disclosed. The filing is a regulatory milestone update, not a special-situations event.
